findings.claim: Alpha current contract pricing is 120 CNY/month with required CSV export included; total monthly cost is 120 CNY.
Beta current contract pricing is 90 CNY/month plus 40 CNY/month for required CSV export; total monthly cost is 130 CNY.

CSV export and CN data residency are required, with a monthly budget of 150 CNY. Alpha provides CSV export and CN residency at 120 CNY/month, so it is eligible. Beta with CSV export costs 130 CNY/month and meets the budget, but its EU data region fails CN residency, so it is ineligible. Recommend Alpha.
Beta marketing claims no downtime ever, but the incident evidence records a 30-minute Beta outage, contradicting that claim. The marketing also provides no measured availability evidence.

Availability percentage is unknown: the incident evidence records 30 minutes for Beta and 10 minutes for Alpha but specifies no observation window, so these durations cannot establish an availability percentage.
The old Alpha price is explicitly superseded by the current S2 contract and is excluded from all cost calculations.
